title: Report
description: Report options (M7.1, ADR-074): what a simulation's report prints (its sections, the saved views drawn as result plots, the title block) and the user's own company name and logo, which every report of theirs carries. The report job (M7.3) reads them, with the figures captured in the browser for a run (M7.2, ADR-011). Text is printed as typed. Each message is a definition under $defs.

ReportSection.description: A section the report can print, from DECISIONS.md's Report row: project and revision, geometry and units, materials, mesh statistics, each load and support with a picture, solver settings and versions, result plots, the reaction (or heat) balance check, minimum and maximum tables, run warnings. The standing statements (M7.5) are always printed and are not a section.

ReportText.description: One line of the title block or the company name, printed as typed; may be empty.

TitleBlock.description: The title block printed on the cover and in every page header. Empty fields are left out.

ReportOptions.description: Body of PUT /api/simulations/:id/report-options. Sections are printed in the order of ReportSection whatever order they are listed in; views (ids of the simulation's saved views, ADR-055) are drawn as result plots in the order listed.

unitSystem.description: Id of the unit system in packages/spec/units.json that every value of the report prints in (M7.6, ADR-076), whatever the browser's result view shows. Starts as the project's unit system; an id the table no longer lists is answered as the project's.

ReportOptionsResponse.description: Answer to GET and PUT /api/simulations/:id/report-options. Until options are saved the answer holds the defaults (every section, no views, the simulation's name as the title, the project's unit system) with saved false. Views deleted since are left out.

ReportLogo.description: The user's logo: a PNG or JPEG image, its size in bytes and in pixels. The image itself is GET /api/report-branding/logo.

ReportBranding.description: The company name and logo every report of the user carries, set once per user.

SaveReportBrandingRequest.description: Body of PUT /api/report-branding. The logo is sent on its own to POST /api/report-branding/logo.

ReportFigureKind.description: What a report figure shows (M7.2): one support or one load of the run's setup, drawn on the geometry with its faces picked out, or one saved view of the simulation drawn as saved (a result plot, or the geometry for a view saved without results).

ReportFigure.description: A figure captured in the browser for a run's report (M7.2, ADR-011): a PNG drawn by the same viewer the user sees. kind and item name what it shows: a support or load by its id in the run's frozen setup, or a saved view by its id. The image is GET /api/runs/:id/figures/:kind/:item.

caption.description: The caption printed under the figure, as captured.

position.description: Where the figure comes among the run's figures, from 0.

ReportFigureResponse.description: Answer to PUT /api/runs/:id/figures/:kind/:item, which takes the PNG as the body and the caption and position in the query.

ReportFigureListResponse.description: Answer to GET and DELETE /api/runs/:id/figures: the run's figures in order of position (none after a DELETE).

ReportJobFigure.description: A figure the report job places (M7.3): one of the run's stored figures (ReportFigure), downloaded under file.

file.description: Its download among the job's transfers, for example figure-0.png.

ReportJobText.description: A standing statement or a note as printed, its names already filled from the run (ADR-062, ADR-073).

ReportGeometry.description: The geometry a report's run uses: its uploaded file's name and the length unit confirmed for it. Its bodies and size come from topology.json.

ReportJobParams.description: Parameters of a report job (M7.3, ADR-077), built by the API when the report is asked for from the run's frozen record, the simulation's saved report options and the user's company name and logo. The job downloads the figures, the logo, the geometry's topology.json and the run's solver.log, and uploads report.docx and report.pdf (M7.4). run and meshQuality are a RunView and a MeshQuality of simulation.schema.json, which the job checks against that schema.

generatedAt.description: When the report was asked for (UTC, ISO 8601); its date is the report's date.

unitSystem.description: Id of the unit system in packages/spec/units.json that every value prints in (M7.6).

sections.description: The sections to print, in printing order.

logo.description: The user's logo, downloaded as logo; null when they have none.

run.description: The run as its owner sees it (RunView in simulation.schema.json); it has succeeded.

meshQuality.description: The quality summary of the run's mesh (MeshQuality in simulation.schema.json); null for meshes made before M2.8.

figures.description: The run's stored figures in order, without those of sections not printed.

statements.description: The standing statements, in printing order.

notes.description: The notes the run's frozen setup calls for, in printing order.

ReportJobResult.description: Result of a succeeded report job (M7.3): the size of report.docx, the size of report.pdf printed from it (M7.4; absent from reports made before) and how many figures it placed.

ReportStatus.description: Where a run's report is: queued for the worker, being made, made (it can be downloaded) or failed.

RunReport.description: The latest report asked for of a run (M7.3). Once it has succeeded its DOCX is GET /api/runs/:id/report/docx and its PDF (M7.4) GET /api/runs/:id/report/pdf.

problem.description: Why it failed, in plain language.

pdfSizeBytes.description: Size of its PDF; null until it has succeeded, and for a report made before M7.4, which has none.

RunReportResponse.description: Answer to GET and POST /api/runs/:id/report: the run's latest report, or null when none has been asked for.

wait.description: On GET while the report job has not finished: a JobWait (jobs.schema.json), checked against that schema by the browser (M11.2, ADR-112).
